entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: A pan-Mesoamerican-inspired hollow plane named after its main continent, full of jungles, dinosaurs, ruins and lost treasures.

entities.name: Aclazotz
entities.description: The last survivor of the Fourth People who became godlike through fear of death, slew a Deep God and sowed fear among the Komon Winaq.

entities.name: Chimil
entities.description: The sun at the center of the Core of Paradise, the mother of the Deep Gods and creator of the first humans.

entities.name: Deep Gods
entities.description: The children of Chimil, born at the dawn of the Fifth Age.

entities.name: Ojer Axonil
entities.description: A Deep God, god of fury and strength, who fought Aclazotz and imprisoned him in the Whispering War.

entities.name: Ojer Taq
entities.description: Axonil's elder sibling, who watched over the Komon's golden age and whom Aclazotz tried to kill.

entities.name: Komon Winaq
entities.description: The first humans of Ixalan, who awoke in the Core of Paradise and later founded the Sun Empire and Oltec civilization.

entities.name: Tan Jolom
entities.description: The first Komon Winaq to circumnavigate the Core, who became an Echo and left a door open to the afterlife.

entities.name: Olanem Teq
entities.description: A heroic Komon figure who led the resistance against the Fomori from Oq'tinimit.

entities.name: Fomori
entities.description: Interplanar colonizers who encased Chimil in a shell of shards and ruled the Core for 320 years before being expelled.

entities.name: Core of Paradise
entities.description: An inverted sphere beneath Ixalan's surface with a sun at its center, where the first humans awoke.

entities.name: Whispering War
entities.description: The war in the Core between Aclazotz's cults and the Komon, ended by the Deep Gods.

entities.name: Night War
entities.description: The war in which the Komon resisted and expelled the Fomori colonizers.

entities.name: Oltec
entities.description: The Komon Winaq who stayed in the Core, ancestors of the Sun Empire.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: The empire founded by Komon who migrated to Ixalan's surface, founded in Orazca by Chacanto Intli.

entities.name: River Heralds
entities.description: The once dominant inhabitants of Ixalan's interior, who warred with the Sun Empire.

entities.name: Legion of Dusk
entities.description: Torrezon's vampire-ruled power that conquered the continent and sought the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Brazen Coalition
entities.description: Pirates formed from refugees of Torrezon's last conquered city-states.

entities.name: Malamet
entities.description: A cavern people who fought alongside the Komon in the Night War and were later driven back underground.

entities.name: Mycoids
entities.description: Fungal creatures born from a disease in the caverns, led by a hivemind called the Mycotyrant.

entities.name: Azor
entities.description: A planeswalker who created the Immortal Sun to trap Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: An artifact that prevented planeswalkers from leaving Ixalan until it was removed in 4560.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The dragon the Immortal Sun was made to trap; one of his henchmen stole it.

entities.name: Pedron the Wicked
entities.description: A rival king who stole the Immortal Sun from its monastery but lost it to Azor.

entities.name: Elenda of Garrano
entities.description: The first vampire, who ended Torrezon's long religious war.

entities.name: Chacanto Intli
entities.description: The founder of the Sun Empire in Orazca.

entities.name: Apatzec Intli I
entities.description: A Sun Empire ruler who used the Immortal Sun without restraint in a devastating war with the River Heralds.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: The lost golden city said to hide the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Torrezon
entities.description: The eastern continent ruled by an alliance of church and monarch, dominated by vampires.

entities.name: Etali
entities.description: An elder dinosaur compleated in the Phyrexian invasion and felled by Zacama.

entities.name: Zacama
entities.description: A dinosaur who felled Etali.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: A character whose forewarning let Pachatupa prepare for the Phyrexian attack.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian invasion of Ixalan by the Alabaster, Copper and Furnace Hosts.

entities.name: Caztaca Huicintli
entities.description: The emperor's sister who plotted to depose her brother Atlacan.

entities.name: Atlacan
entities.description: The bellicose emperor of the Sun Empire.

entities.name: Vona
entities.description: The leader of a rising faction in Torrezon.

entities.name: Beckett Brass
entities.description: A Brazen Coalition admiral who crashed a meeting of the two factions to win a Coalition state.

events.summary: Aclazotz slays the last Deep God before he can emerge, eating him and taking his place.
events.quote: Before the last God could emerge, Aclazotz slew him, eating him and taking his place.

events.summary: The first humans, the Komon Winaq, awake inside the Core of Paradise and understand Chimil as their creator.
events.quote: they would be called the Komon Winaq , or the Fifth People

events.summary: Tan Jolom confirms the Core is a sphere built around a star, then becomes an Echo and departs for the afterlife to find the Deep Gods.
events.quote: So, he became an Echo and departed for the afterlife

events.summary: Aclazotz slips through the door Tan Jolom left open and hardens the veil between life and death, so the dead no longer become Echoes.
events.quote: he hardened the gossamer veil between life and death

events.summary: Aclazotz's cults spread, and the Whispering War erupts when leaders try to stop them.
events.quote: Aclazotz's cults fought back, and the fields and cities of the Komon raged with violence.

events.summary: Ojer Axonil leads a thousand champions, defeats Aclazotz, tears out one of his eyes and imprisons him, ending the Whispering War.
events.quote: tore out one of Aclazotz's eyes and imprisoned him

events.summary: The Komon build a golden Age of the Sun lasting millennia, founding Oteclan on Lake Wachibal.
events.quote: the Komon Winaq built a golden age that lasted for millennia

events.summary: The Fomori arrive, end the Age of the Sun and enclose Chimil in a shell, plunging the Core into darkness.
events.quote: the Fomori completed their shell around Chimil, and total darkness fell throughout the Core

events.summary: Olanem Teq leads the resistance in the Night War against the Fomori.
events.quote: Teq led the resistance, raiding Fomori cylinders

events.summary: Chimil shatters the shards, blasting away the Fomori and empowering the Komon into Ixalan's first angels; the Deep Gods return.
events.quote: the first angels of Ixalan

events.summary: The Fomori are expelled from the Core, ending the Night War.
events.quote: The war ended with the Fomori expelled from the Core

events.summary: Hundreds of thousands of Komon Winaq migrate to the surface, later becoming the Sun Empire, while those who stay become the Oltec.
events.quote: Those who stayed behind began to call themselves Oltec .

events.summary: A fungal outbreak at Topizielo spawns the mycoids, which overrun the caverns; the Oltec seal the Core's entrances.
events.quote: Those who remained in the caverns sealed all entrances to the Core to protect it from the spread of the mycoids.

events.summary: Azor creates the Immortal Sun in 3279 AR to trap Nicol Bolas, preventing planeswalkers from leaving Ixalan.
events.quote: the planeswalker Azor created a powerful artifact known as the Immortal Sun to trap Nicol Bolas .

events.summary: Pedron the Wicked steals the Immortal Sun from its monastery but Azor reclaims it.
events.quote: stole the Immortal Sun but lost it to Azor, who reclaimed it

events.summary: The first vampire, Elenda of Garrano, ends Torrezon's three-century religious war; the Legion of Dusk conquers the continent and the Brazen Coalition forms.
events.quote: their inhabitants took to the sea and formed the Brazen Coalition

events.summary: Apatzec Intli I uses the Immortal Sun without restraint in a devastating war with the River Heralds.
events.quote: who had gained possession of the Immortal Sun and used it without restraint

events.summary: The Immortal Sun is stolen and removed from the plane by a henchman of Bolas, breaking the barrier.
events.quote: was stolen and removed from the plane by a henchman of Bolas

events.summary: The Sun Empire retakes Orazca and pushes the Legion of Dusk back, then launches the Dawn Fleet toward Torrezon.
events.quote: the Sun Empire pushed the Legion of Dusk back to the sea

events.summary: Etali is compleated and hurricanes form off Ixalan as the plane mobilizes against the New Phyrexian threat.
events.quote: After the elder dinosaur Etali was compleated

events.summary: Phyrexian Hosts invade Ixalan's continent; tens of thousands are Phyrexianized, and Pachatupa holds thanks to Huatli's warning.
events.quote: Within days, tens of thousands of humans and regiments of dinosaurs were Phyrexianized.

events.summary: The Sun Empire, pirates and the Legion of Dusk unite and Zacama fells Etali, saving Ixalan from the Phyrexians.
events.quote: Etali was finally felled by Zacama after injuring Zetalpa

events.summary: The Phyrexian invasion exposes entrances to the Core and awakens Aclazotz.
events.quote: the bat god Aclazotz was awoken from his slumber

events.summary: The Legion of Dusk frees Aclazotz, who tries to snuff out the inner sun, while the Mycotyrant attacks the Oltec; both are defeated but escape to the surface.
events.quote: The latter faction freed Aclazotz, who then attempted to snuff out the plane's inner sun.

events.summary: The Sun Empire builds a second Dawn Fleet and Admiral Beckett Brass crashes a meeting, agreeing to support both factions for a Coalition state.
events.quote: Admiral Beckett Brass crashed a meeting of the two factions
